verdict.rationale: Intel documents official developer SDKs/toolkits (oneAPI, oneDNN, OpenVINO, DPC++ Compatibility Tool, VTune Profiler) explicitly aimed at building AI/LLM applications on Core Ultra hardware. However, evidence is entirely first-party marketing/docs pages with no independent developer corroboration, code samples, or API reference depth. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer validation of the SDKs, concrete API documentation or code examples, and confirmation of stability/versioning support.
